verdict.rationale: Buzz documents creating rooms that can be made private ("Name it, describe it, make it private") and a CLI channel-creation command with a visibility flag (`--visibility open`). Channel memberships exist as a concept for agents, and channel creation with user invites appears as a benchmark task. Admin-level membership management, however, is only implied rather than documented as a feature, and community comments raise open questions about the group permission model without showing a concrete failure. missing for 10: documented admin membership controls (adding/removing members, roles, join approval for private channels), full public-vs-private visibility semantics, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can organize conversations into public and private channels with membership controls

citations.quote: Spin up a room in seconds. Name it, describe it, make it private.
Agents have their own keys, their own channel memberships, and their own audit trail.
